## Part 1

Fitting 150L of eegnog

```{r}
input <- read_lines(I(
  "50
44
11
49
42
46
18
32
26
40
21
7
18
43
10
47
36
24
22
40"
)) |>
  as.integer()

#input <- c(20L, 15L, 10L, 5L, 5L)

map(seq_along(input), \(x) combn(input, x, simplify = FALSE)) |>
  flatten() |>
  map_int(sum) -> sums
sum(sums == 150L)
```


28467274 too high 1.3s (used indices!)
654 

## Part 2


```{r}
tibble(
  comb = map(seq_along(input), \(x) combn(input, x, simplify = FALSE)) |>
    flatten()
) |>
  mutate(right_sum = map_int(comb, sum), containers = lengths(comb)) |>
  filter(right_sum == 150L) |>
  slice_min(containers)
```


57 1.1s
